product.title: Oahu: Chief's Luau Admission Including Transfers

description.text: Immerse yourself in Hawaiian culture with a visit to a traditional luau. Your driver will pick you up at your hotel and take you to the luau, where you'll be greeted with a lei and a cocktail. During the course of the evening, you'll have your fill of Hawaiian food while watching a live Polynesian show. Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
